why: HELD OUT. Written on 20 September 2026 against the frozen implementation at commit 412b24a, and committed BEFORE it was run even once. A corpus that has found a defect has, by finding it, stopped being able to find the next one: every line of the fix for anchors A and B was written while looking at docs/testing/spoken-corpus.json, so that file is regression material and is no longer evidence. Nothing here reuses a sentence, a noun or a shape from it. The freeze is a commit hash rather than an intention.
how: Each case says what a careful person reading the sentence would agree Grant is asking for. `surviving` is the kinds, in the order he said them; `abandoned` is how many clauses he started and replaced. `other` and an empty list are the same outcome — both end in the cascade doing nothing and Claire simply replying.
